challenges.question: Could the global gauge fixing g1=1 itself be the missing physical transverse quotient?
challenges.reason: It fixes the already-consumed global SL(2,C) redundancy of the vertex before the raw 12-dimensional tangent map is formed; no source projection from that raw tangent space to a further physical transverse quotient is defined.

challenges.question: Could CP1 invariance of the auxiliary spinor integral supply the quotient?
challenges.reason: The projectivization is z_ab~alpha z_ab in the auxiliary one-wedge spinor variable. It is not a quotient/projection of Eq.(4) group tangent variables X2,X3 and cannot be substituted across variable classes.

challenges.question: Could one infer a standard complement to gauge directions or an orthogonal transverse subspace?
challenges.reason: No admissible primary record fixes such a complement, metric, or projection; choosing one would be a post-hoc textbook completion.

challenges.question: Does the complete arXiv v1 record explicitly define all three preregistered quotient fields?
challenges.reason: The complete v1 text defines Eq.(4), g1=1 gauge fixing, g_ab, B(z,g), CP1 spinor measure and the one-wedge contact distribution, but no same-realization physical transverse quotient/projection/contact pullback from the raw group tangent variables.

challenges.question: Can the Critic certify that the published PRD version also lacks the definitions?
challenges.reason: The version-of-record full text is not completely auditable in the current authority environment. Public APS metadata/abstract is available and states the accepted manuscript will be public starting 2027-06-15, but that is not a substitute for a full-text audit.

challenges.question: Was an admissible publisher-linked supplement or explicitly paper-linked author derivation/code found?
challenges.reason: Exact-title/DOI and author-link searches surfaced no admissible official supplement or paper-linked derivation/code. Talks/slides and companion papers remain outside the frozen authority boundary.

claim_ceiling: The gate may state that the frozen auditable authority does not establish the physical quotient/projection. It may not state that every inaccessible primary version definitively lacks such a definition, and it may not infer physical transversality failure.
